current_batch.scope: source-only field-interaction contracts, scripted preview, privacy, provenance, explicit review, accessible presentation, deterministic verification

non_claims: No microphone, camera, file picker, speech recognizer, OCR, vision model, or external AI service is activated.

No authentication, bearer-token attachment, backend request, protected-content access, engineering approval, operational authorization, production deployment, PWA caching, or native packaging is performed.
No standards conformity or best-brand conclusion is claimed.
objectives: Allow field users to express requirements through controlled voice transcripts and multimodal source descriptors.
Preserve source provenance, privacy classification, retention controls, evidence visibility, and explicit review before any query or command preparation.
Introduce activation only through bounded evidence gates for permissions, capture, processing providers, authentication, backend transport, protected-content access, deployment, and native packaging.
title: Voice, multimodal field interaction, and controlled activation execution

workstreams.name: source_and_provenance
workstreams.scope: Manual and scripted transcript, image, and document descriptors with integrity metadata and no raw-content claim.

workstreams.name: privacy_and_retention
workstreams.scope: Classification, consent, data-owner review, memory-only default retention, and external-processing denial without accepted evidence.

workstreams.name: intent_and_review
workstreams.scope: Deterministic proposal contracts, no automatic operation selection, and explicit local-preview review state.

workstreams.name: permission_and_capture_activation
workstreams.scope: Microphone, camera, and file-selection readiness followed by separately accepted user-gesture and browser evidence.

workstreams.name: processing_adapters
workstreams.scope: Later local or external speech, OCR, and vision adapters only after privacy, security, licensing, data-location, and quality evidence.

workstreams.name: protected_execution
workstreams.scope: Later authenticated backend-authoritative query and command execution with entitlement, audit, approval, cancellation, and zero-retry controls.

workstreams.name: deployment_and_devices
workstreams.scope: Later browser, accessibility, responsive-device, history fallback, supported hosting, PWA, and native-mobile gates.
